title: Chemin de Fer
stakeGuide: You hold the bank. Choose how much to stake ({{min}}-{{max}})
punterGuide: The punter total is 5. You may draw or stand
bankerGuide: You are the banker. You may draw or stand at any total
forcedNotice: This total leaves no choice (0-4 must draw, 6-7 must stand)
tutorial.seats: One of the six seats holds the bank. It passes on when the banker loses
tutorial.stake: The banker chooses how much to stake here
tutorial.bet: Punters share the bank between them. The highest bettor decides for the side
tutorial.draw: Only the punter's 0-4 and 6-7 are fixed; a 5 and the banker choose freely
frontendHint.chemindeferPunterFive: Drawing on 5 is the standard play
frontendHint.chemindeferBankerFree: The banker is not bound by the table. Read the punter's third card
